description: Period totals for a site: pageviews, visitors, bounce rate, avg session time, optional revenue, optional compare window. Optional filters: JSON array [{ "d": "country", "o": "is", "v": ["DE"] }]. Values OR within a dimension, AND across dimensions. Region uses country:region (e.g. US:CA). Revenue is absent (not zero) when no payment provider is connected. compare is previous | yoy | custom; custom needs compareStart and compareEnd (YYYY-MM-DD). Read-only.

filters.description: Dashboard filters as JSON array, e.g. [{ "d": "country", "o": "is", "v": ["DE"] }]. Values within a dimension are OR'd; dimensions are AND'd. Region values are country:region (e.g. US:CA).

format.description: Output shape: table (default) or raw json.

name: get_stats
